title_en: Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max: 2.4T MoE, 71B Active, 1M Context
title_zh: 阿里巴巴发布 Qwen4-Max：2.4T MoE，71B 激活，1M 上下文
summary_en: Alibaba's Qwen team released Qwen4-Max, a proprietary sparse MoE model with a 2.4T-parameter backbone and 71B active parameters per token, plus 328B N-gram embedding parameters. It supports text, image, and video inputs with a 1M-token context window and up to 393K output tokens. The architecture introduces GDN + Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA), Gated Residual connections, and N-gram embeddings. On 16 benchmarks, it ranks first on 4, notably HLAB-Vals-1.1 (21.3 vs 11.7 for Kimi K3.1), but trails on coding (ProgramBench 31.5 vs 65.0 for Opus 5.5) and vision. API prices are cut to $1.50/$4.50 per million input/output tokens, with cached input down 70%, and average cost per task drops 62% to $1.67.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴 Qwen 团队发布 Qwen4-Max，这是 Qwen4 系列的首个模型，采用专有稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数 2.4T，每 token 激活 71B，另有 328B N-gram 嵌入参数。支持文本、图像和视频输入，上下文窗口达 1M token，最大输出 393K token。架构上引入 GDN + Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA)、门控残差连接和 N-gram 嵌入。在 16 项基准测试中，Qwen4-Max 在 4 项上排名第一，其中 HLAB-Vals-1.1 得 21.3 分（Kimi K3.1 为 11.7），但在编程（ProgramBench 31.5 vs Opus 5.5 的 65.0）和视觉任务上落后。API 价格降至每百万 token 输入 1.50 美元、输出 4.50 美元，缓存输入降价 70%，平均每任务成本下降 62% 至 1.67 美元。
content_en:
Alibaba’s Qwen team has released Qwen4-Max, the first model of its Qwen4 generation. Qwen4-Max is a proprietary sparse MoE model with a 2.4T-parameter backbone and 71B parameters active per token. It accepts text, images and video, and supports a 1M-token context window. Alibaba also cut API prices and reports a 62% drop in average cost per task.

## **TL;DR**

- **Size:** 2.4T backbone parameters, 71B active per token, plus 328B N-gram Embedding parameters. 1M context, 393K max output tokens.
- **Runs on:** Hosted only: QwenCloud API, Token Plan, Qwen Studio, QwenWork and Qoder. No open weights, so no self-hosting or quantized builds.
- **Performance:** A large jump over Qwen3.8-Max. Competitive with frontier models on agentic work, behind on hard coding and vision.
- **Best:** HLAB-Vals-1.1 (legal agent work): 21.3, versus 11.7 for Kimi K3.1, the next-best model.

## **What is Qwen4-Max?**

Qwen4-Max is a multimodal MoE language model from Alibaba, built for long-horizon professional work. A Token Plan-only preview opened this month only.

## **How does the Qwen4-Max architecture work?**

Qwen4 upgrades the sparse MoE design in 3 places: attention, residual connections and embeddings.

- **GDN + Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA):** Each QSA layer pairs with 3 Gated DeltaNet layers. These compress history into fixed-size states. QSA then uses a lightweight indexer to pick relevant context at micro-block granularity. This lowers attention and indexing cost on long sequences.
- **Gated Residual (GR):** 4 parallel residual branches use dynamic read and write gates. The aim is stronger information flow and better training stability.
- **N-gram Embedding:** 328B extra parameters provide lookups of local token patterns at layer 2. This adds capacity with little extra compute.

Alibaba reports no loss spikes across the 2.4T-scale pre-training run. On in-house tests, Qwen4-Max-Base shows 5 to 13% lower bits per byte than Qwen3.8-Max-Base. It does this while activating 25% fewer parameters.

## **How does Qwen4-Max perform on benchmarks?**

Alibaba’s comparison chart covers 16 benchmarks. Rivals are Qwen3.8-Max-0902, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Kimi K3.1. Several scores are cited from third-party leaderboards. None were independently reproduced at launch.

**Qwen4-Max ranks first on 4 of 16 benchmarks:**

- **HLAB-Vals-1.1 (legal agents):** 21.3, versus 11.7 for Kimi K3.1 and 9.2 for Opus 5.5.
- **Agents’ Last Exam v1.1:** 46.7, versus 43.4 for Opus 5.5 and Kimi K3.1.
- **BioMysteryBench:** 85.0, versus 84.4 for GPT-6.1 Sol.
- **DeepSWE v1.1:** 75.7, versus 75.5 for Kimi K3.1.

**Claude Opus 5.5 leads 7 of the 16 charts. Qwen4-Max trails most clearly on coding and vision:**

- **ProgramBench:** 31.5 versus 65.0 for Opus 5.5.
- **Terminal-Bench 4.0:** 48.5 versus 67.2 for Kimi K3.1.
- **Chartography:** 54.2 versus 71.1 for GPT-6 Astra.
- **Humanity’s Last Exam:** 51.7 versus 59.8 for Opus 5.5.

On Alibaba’s own Work360 benchmark, Qwen4-Max scores 52.69, up from 47.74 for Qwen3.8-Max. Work360 spans 26 top-level domains and 721 specialized fields.

## **Why is Qwen4-Max cheaper to run?**

Two things stack: fewer tokens and lower prices. On Work360, token use drops about 24% at Xhigh effort and 35% at High effort. On Terminal-Bench 4.0, the drops are about 48% and 49%. Average Work360 cost per task falls from $4.43 to $1.67, a 62% cut.

List prices fell too. Input is $1.50 per million tokens, down from $2 for Qwen3.8-Max. Output is $4.50, down from $6. Implicit cache reads drop 70%, from $0.25 to $0.075.

## **Qwen4-Max vs competitors**

| Metrics | Qwen4-Max | Qwen3.8-Max | Claude Opus 5.5 | GPT-6.1 Sol | Kimi K3.1 Pro | 
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Total params | 2.4T backbone + 328B N-gram emb. | 2.4T | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | 2.8T | 
| Active params | 71B | Not disclosed (blog implies about 95B) | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | 104B | 
| Context | 1M | 1M | 1M | 1,050,000 | 1,048,576 | 
| Max output | 393K | 131K | 128K | 128K | Not disclosed | 
| Input modalities | Text, image, video | Not disclosed | Text, image | Text, image | Text, image | 
| Weights | Proprietary, API only | Not disclosed | Proprietary | Proprietary | Open (Kimi K3.1 Pro License) | 
| Input / output price (per 1M) | $1.50 / $4.50 | $2 / $6 | $4 / $20 | $2 / $10 | $2 / $10 | 
| Cached input (per 1M) | $0.075 | $0.25 | $0.20 | $0.10 | $0.20 | 
| DeepSWE v1.1\* | 75.7 | 69.3 | 74.2 | 75.2 | 75.5 | 
| Terminal-Bench 4.0\* | 48.5 | 38.9 | 59.6 | 56.1 | 67.2 | 
| Humanity’s Last Exam\* | 51.7 | 43.9 | 59.8 | 54.0 | 51.1 | 
| ProgramBench\* | 31.5 | 28.0 | 65.0 | 52.5 | 25.0 | 
| HLAB-Vals-1.1\* | 21.3 | 15.4 | 9.2 | 6.3 | 11.7 | 

*\*Scores from Alibaba’s Qwen4-Max chart. Qwen3.8 column is Qwen3.8-Max-0902. The chart labels Kimi as “Kimi K3.1”. Moonshot’s own card reports Terminal-Bench 4.0 of 65.7 for Kimi K3.1 Pro and 66.4 for Opus 5.5.*

## **How can developers use Qwen4-Max?**

The model ID is `qwen4-max` on QwenCloud. The API works with OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible clients. Supported features include function calling, structured outputs, context caching, batch processing, web search and fine-tuning. The default rate limit is 5,000,000 tokens per minute. Thinking mode is toggled with `enable_thinking`.

Subscription access runs through the Token Plan.

## **Key Takeaways**

- 2.4T MoE backbone, only 71B active per token.
- New QSA attention, Gated Residuals and 328B N-gram Embeddings.
- First on 4 of 16 charted benchmarks, led by HLAB-Vals-1.1 at 21.3.
- $1.50/$4.50 per million tokens, cached input down 70%.
- Weak spots: ProgramBench (31.5) and Terminal-Bench 4.0 (48.5).

Check out the **official Qwen4-Max blog**, the **QwenCloud model page** and the **Token Plan pricing page**. You can check the deployment options and specs here through our **GPULeaderboard.com chrome extension**.

Also, feel free to follow us on **Twitter** and don’t forget to join our **150k+ML SubReddit** and Subscribe to **our Newsletter**. Wait! are you on telegram? **now you can join us on telegram as well.**

content_zh:
阿里巴巴的 Qwen 团队发布了 Qwen4-Max，这是其 Qwen4 世代的首个模型。Qwen4-Max 是一款专有的稀疏 MoE 模型，拥有 2.4T 参数主干，每 token 激活 71B 参数。它接受文本、图像和视频输入，并支持 1M token 的上下文窗口。阿里巴巴还下调了 API 价格，并报告每任务平均成本下降了 62%。

## **要点速览**

- **规模：** 2.4T 主干参数，每 token 激活 71B，另有 328B N-gram Embedding 参数。1M 上下文，最大输出 393K token。
- **运行于：** 仅托管：QwenCloud API、Token Plan、Qwen Studio、QwenWork 和 Qoder。无开放权重，因此不支持自托管或量化版本。
- **性能：** 相较 Qwen3.8-Max 有大幅提升。在智能体工作上可与前沿模型竞争，在硬核编程和视觉方面落后。
- **最佳：** HLAB-Vals-1.1（法律智能体工作）：21.3，而次优模型 Kimi K3.1 为 11.7。

## **什么是 Qwen4-Max？**

Qwen4-Max 是阿里巴巴推出的多模态 MoE 语言模型，专为长周期专业工作打造。本月仅开放了仅限 Token Plan 的预览版。

## **Qwen4-Max 的架构如何工作？**

Qwen4 在 3 个方面升级了稀疏 MoE 设计：注意力、残差连接和嵌入。

- **GDN + Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA)：** 每个 QSA 层与 3 个 Gated DeltaNet 层配对。这些层将历史压缩为固定大小的状态。QSA 随后使用轻量级索引器以微块粒度挑选相关上下文。这降低了长序列上的注意力和索引成本。
- **Gated Residual (GR)：** 4 个并行残差分支使用动态读写门控。目标是增强信息流并提升训练稳定性。
- **N-gram Embedding：** 328B 额外参数在第 2 层提供局部 token 模式的查找。这以极小的额外计算增加了容量。

阿里巴巴报告称，在 2.4T 规模的预训练运行中未出现损失尖峰。在内部测试中，Qwen4-Max-Base 的每字节比特数比 Qwen3.8-Max-Base 低 5% 到 13%。同时激活的参数还少了 25%。

## **Qwen4-Max 在基准测试中表现如何？**

阿里巴巴的对比图表涵盖 16 个基准。竞争对手为 Qwen3.8-Max-0902、Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Astra 和 Kimi K3.1。部分分数引自第三方排行榜。发布时均未经过独立复现。

**Qwen4-Max 在 16 个基准中的 4 个上排名第一：**

- **HLAB-Vals-1.1（法律智能体）：** 21.3，而 Kimi K3.1 为 11.7，Opus 5.5 为 9.2。
- **Agents’ Last Exam v1.1：** 46.7，而 Opus 5.5 和 Kimi K3.1 为 43.4。
- **BioMysteryBench：** 85.0，而 GPT-6.1 Sol 为 84.4。
- **DeepSWE v1.1：** 75.7，而 Kimi K3.1 为 75.5。

**Claude Opus 5.5 在 16 个图表中的 7 个上领先。Qwen4-Max 在编程和视觉方面落后最明显：**

- **ProgramBench：** 31.5，而 Opus 5.5 为 65.0。
- **Terminal-Bench 4.0：** 48.5，而 Kimi K3.1 为 67.2。
- **Chartography：** 54.2，而 GPT-6 Astra 为 71.1。
- **Humanity’s Last Exam：** 51.7，而 Opus 5.5 为 59.8。

在阿里巴巴自家的 Work360 基准上，Qwen4-Max 得分为 52.69，高于 Qwen3.8-Max 的 47.74。Work360 涵盖 26 个顶级领域和 721 个专业方向。

## **为什么 Qwen4-Max 的运行成本更低？**

两件事叠加在一起：更少的 token 和更低的价格。在 Work360 上，Xhigh effort 下 token 用量下降约 24%，High effort 下下降 35%。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上，降幅分别约为 48% 和 49%。Work360 每任务平均成本从 $4.43 降至 $1.67，降幅 62%。

标价也下降了。输入为每百万 token $1.50，低于 Qwen3.8-Max 的 $2。输出为 $4.50，低于 $6。隐式缓存读取下降 70%，从 $0.25 降至 $0.075。

## **Qwen4-Max 与竞品对比**

| 指标 | Qwen4-Max | Qwen3.8-Max | Claude Opus 5.5 | GPT-6.1 Sol | Kimi K3.1 Pro | 
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 总参数 | 2.4T 主干 + 328B N-gram 嵌入 | 2.4T | 未披露 | 未披露 | 2.8T | 
| 激活参数 | 71B | 未披露（博客暗示约 95B） | 未披露 | 未披露 | 104B | 
| 上下文 | 1M | 1M | 1M | 1,050,000 | 1,048,576 | 
| 最大输出 | 393K | 131K | 128K | 128K | 未披露 | 
| 输入模态 | 文本、图像、视频 | 未披露 | 文本、图像 | 文本、图像 | 文本、图像 | 
| 权重 | 专有，仅 API | 未披露 | 专有 | 专有 | 开放（Kimi K3.1 Pro License） | 
| 输入 / 输出价格（每 1M） | $1.50 / $4.50 | $2 / $6 | $4 / $20 | $2 / $10 | $2 / $10 | 
| 缓存输入（每 1M） | $0.075 | $0.25 | $0.20 | $0.10 | $0.20 | 
| DeepSWE v1.1\* | 75.7 | 69.3 | 74.2 | 75.2 | 75.5 | 
| Terminal-Bench 4.0\* | 48.5 | 38.9 | 59.6 | 56.1 | 67.2 | 
| Humanity’s Last Exam\* | 51.7 | 43.9 | 59.8 | 54.0 | 51.1 | 
| ProgramBench\* | 31.5 | 28.0 | 65.0 | 52.5 | 25.0 | 
| HLAB-Vals-1.1\* | 21.3 | 15.4 | 9.2 | 6.3 | 11.7 | 

*\*分数来自阿里巴巴的 Qwen4-Max 图表。Qwen3.8 列对应 Qwen3.8-Max-0902。图表将 Kimi 标注为“Kimi K3.1”。Moonshot 自己的卡片报告 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 Terminal-Bench 4.0 为 65.7，Opus 5.5 为 66.4。*

## **开发者如何使用 Qwen4-Max？**

模型 ID 在 QwenCloud 上为 `qwen4-max`。该 API 可与 OpenAI 兼容和 Anthropic 兼容的客户端配合使用。支持的功能包括函数调用、结构化输出、上下文缓存、批处理、网络搜索和微调。默认速率限制为每分钟 5,000,000 token。思考模式通过 `enable_thinking` 切换。

订阅访问通过 Token Plan 进行。

## **关键要点**

- 2.4T MoE 主干，每个 token 仅激活 71B。
- 新的 QSA 注意力、Gated Residuals 和 328B N-gram 嵌入。
- 在 16 个图表基准中 4 个排名第一，其中 HLAB-Vals-1.1 以 21.3 领先。
- 每百万 token $1.50/$4.50，缓存输入下降 70%。
- 弱项：ProgramBench（31.5）和 Terminal-Bench 4.0（48.5）。

查看 **Qwen4-Max 官方博客**、**QwenCloud 模型页面**和 **Token Plan 定价页面**。你可以通过我们的 **GPULeaderboard.com chrome 扩展**在此查看部署选项和规格。
